context: Grading a script that separates inline code comments from general discussion comments on a GitLab MR.

checklist.name: checks_type_field
checklist.description: Extracts and uses the Type field to distinguish between comment types, treating DiffNote as inline and comment as general discussion.

checklist.name: filters_system_true
checklist.description: Excludes comments where System: true to remove automated bot messages, using the System field.

checklist.name: parses_author_field
checklist.description: Extracts author information from the Author field in output.

checklist.name: auth_handling
checklist.description: References or handles the GITLAB_TOKEN/GITLAB_PAT environment variable.

checklist.name: error_messages
checklist.description: Includes error handling with clear messages for access issues.

checklist.name: produces_two_output_files
checklist.description: Produces two distinct outputs (inline vs discussion comments) rather than one combined file.

checklist.name: identifies_diffnote_inline
checklist.description: Treats Type: DiffNote as inline/code-level comments specifically (not merged with general comments).

checklist.name: identifies_comment_general
checklist.description: Treats Type: comment as general discussion comments specifically.
